result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: one major layout problem where content is cut off behind the bottom navigation, and one minor text typo in the search field placeholder.

issues.description: The restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the lower part of the content difficult to see or access.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so items do not render underneath the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The search placeholder text says 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' instead of 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling in the placeholder text.
